events.title: FREE CONCERT: Beach Jam (2nd Annual Pick, Paddle & Play Beach Jam)
events.description:
The 2nd Annual Pick, Paddle & Play Beach Jam will be held at Causeway Cove Marina in Fort Pierce on Saturday, Nov. 14, from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. The free, all-day concert and community festival benefits Treasure Coast cancer-support organizations Friends in Pink and Care Bag.

Hosted by Stabilize Revitalize Fort Pierce, Inc., the event features live music, paddleboarding, a skate jam, kids’ activities, vendors, food trucks, family-friendly games and a Community Resource Village with local nonprofits. Kairo Reef is among the confirmed performers, with additional acts still being finalized.

Beach Jam also serves as a cancer-awareness fundraiser, with a portion of net proceeds supporting Friends in Pink and Care Bag and the patients and families they serve. The inaugural 2025 Beach Jam raised more than $10,000 to help a local woman facing cancer with housing costs.

Admission is free.
